text:
Under the tracks between JR Osaka and Hankyu Umeda there's a food alley that opened in 1950 as a way for former railway workers to earn a living.

Today about 200 tiny shops squeeze into its two maze-like floors, including a coffee shop pouring since 1968. Most people walk straight past it to the malls.

Follow Japan by Station for one Japan place a day.
